source: Original MIT regression decks; ngspice-47 bjtnoise.c / bjtload.c
command: spice-heavy ngspice -b case.cir (append one command per line: .control; set numdgt=17; noise v(out) Vinput dec 1 100 1Meg; setplot noise1; print onoise_spectrum inoise_spectrum; setplot noise2; print onoise_total inoise_total; quit; .endc; .end)

cases.name: equal-irb
cases.deck:
* Original MIT BJT gx noise regression (#1347)
VDD vdd 0 DC 5
Vinput in 0 DC 0.75 AC 1
Rbase in base 100
Rload vdd out 1k
Q1 out base 0 QMOD
.model QMOD NPN (IS=1e-14 BF=100 BR=1 VAF=100 IKF=0.01 CJE=20p CJC=10p TF=0.3n RB=1000 RBM=1000 IRB=10u)
.noise v(out) Vinput dec 1 100 1Meg
